hiddenStatus.note: identical declared states except p-hidden.status; the hidden row has effects=256 (EFFECT_HIDDEN) and sits inside the view box

counts.note: state.players are the current rows; state.roster is the retained, never-shortened id list (removed ids stay). hud.playerCount is players.size and hud.alive counts every stored row whose status is Alive, before sight filtering.

schemaBoundary.source: packages/shared/src/schema.ts RaidState (minPlayers/startedWith uint8, winner string) with @colyseus/schema Encoder.encodeAll/Decoder.decode
schemaBoundary.note: The in-process schema instance accepts any host number without a range check; the uint8 wire encoding truncates modulo 256 and the decoder returns the truncated value. There is no silent refusal at capture time.
